title: Symmetric Grassmann Formulas: Monotone Dimension-Defect Hierarchies
summary: We study the dimension defect of finitely many subspaces over an arbitrary field. We derive a symmetric, nonrecursive Grassmann-type formula for the dimension of their sum. The formula expresses the total dimension loss through intersections of a distinguished subspace with partial sums of the remaining subspaces, with coefficients determined by the number of subspaces involved. We also show that the formula admits a Shapley-value interpretation for the associated representable polymatroid.
